There are two forms. One mostly passes right through you. The other is classified as a known cause of cancer in people. Florida's report gives one number per candy and never says which.

This week the FDA tested baby formula and found arsenic in 294 of 312 samples. And the FDA did say which kind: inorganic, the cancer-classified one.

So if one lab can tell you, why couldn't the other? And what does all this mean for the 1 in 7 American babies who never get any breast milk at all?
